title: Distribution channels, commissions and disclosures
objectives: Explain how distributors are paid and why Direct and Regular plans differ.
State the disclosure duties around commission.
body_md:
## How the distributor is paid

- **Trail commission** from the scheme's **TER**, paid for as long as the client stays invested. It is reflected in the **Regular plan** NAV.
- **Upfront commission has been banned**; distributors must not pay or receive it from investor money.
- **Direct plans** carry no distributor commission, and the NAV is higher by the cost difference.
- Additional TER for inflows from beyond the top cities existed in the past; check the current expense circular.

## Channels

| Channel | Examples |
|---|---|
| **Independent distributors (IFAs)** | ARN holders advising individuals |
| **Banks and national distributors** | Large networks |
| **Online platforms** | Direct and Regular options, execution only |
| **Registered investment advisers** | Fee-only, paid by the client |

## Disclosures

- Quote your **ARN** and **EUIN** on forms.
- Give the client the **commission information** on request and in line with AMFI guidance.
- Tell the investor that Direct plans exist.
- Disclose any conflict, such as higher commission on one scheme.

## Conduct

Recommend on **client need**, not on commission. Never rebate commission in cash or by gifts outside the allowed norms.

> **Exam tip:** Trail commission comes from the TER; upfront commission is banned.
example: A Regular plan charges 1.6% and the Direct plan 0.7%: the 0.9% gap funds the distributor's service. On ₹10 lakh that is ₹9,000 a year.
say: You can buy Direct as well; here is what my service for the difference includes.
My commission is disclosed on your statement.
never: I get nothing from this fund.
I will pay you part of my commission in cash.

check.q: Trail commission is paid out of:
check.why: Trail comes from the scheme's expense ratio.

check.q: Which identifies the person who advised the investor on the form?
check.why: EUIN identifies the employee or relationship manager.

check.q: A Direct plan differs from a Regular plan because it has:
check.why: No commission, so a lower TER.
